title: A bounded work-tape head span
statement: Let $T$ be a one-work-tape Turing machine, let $c,d$ be configurations on an input $x$, let $t\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $lo,hi\in\mathbb{Z}$. The predicate defined here holds exactly when $T$ reaches $d$ from $c$ after $t$ steps and, at every time $u\le t$, its work-tape head position lies between $lo$ and $hi$, inclusive.
